excluded_categories: Full unchanged 959-file source bodies (hash inventories retained)
Unlisted databases, secret/session stores and runtime workspaces
Later root gates and integration commits
scope: All ten completed local lifecycle gates, three runners, all 87 independent review manifest entries and its original manifest.
redaction_policy: No sensitive-field matches, sensitive-value redactions or scan exemptions. Ordered parameterized path replacements only.

transformation_rules.name: local_home_slash
transformation_rules.find_parameter: raw_home stripped of trailing slash plus slash

transformation_rules.name: ci_home_slash
transformation_rules.find_parameter: ci_home stripped of trailing slash plus slash

transformation_rules.name: pytest_user_root
transformation_rules.find_parameter: pytest temporary-root prefix followed by basename(raw_home)

aggregate_rule: SHA256 canonical UTF-8 JSON of files/generated_files; sort_keys=True,separators comma/colon,ensure_ascii=False
path_rules: Original .patch/.diff represented as .patch.log/.diff.log; alias mapping is authoritative.
